# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_goblin_boomworks.py" from goblin_data.py. Change the tables there and re-run.

# The inventions (doc 64, section 4.5): privileges of the Tinker Bosses, built, switched off and on, vented and
# repaired in the Boomworks (a player cannot pick them here; the AI gets its inventions from the yearly pulse). Each
# gives one privilege slot back, so that they never fill the estate. The privilege carries the Cool effect; Hot adds
# half of it again, the red the whole (DA_GB_hot.<id>, DA_GB_red.<id>: the monthly pass).

	loyalty = 0
	influence = 0
	is_valid = {

	can_select = {

			tooltip = DA_GB_in_boomworks_tt
			always = no
		}
	}
	can_revoke = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = DA_GB_in_boomworks_tt
			always = no
		}
	}
	on_granted = {
		DA_GB_inv_granted = { inv = stills }
	}
	on_revoked = {
		DA_GB_inv_removed = { inv = stills }

	}

		trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_hot.wasp }
